title: Analysis of Hydrogen Contamination in Al/AlOx/Al Josephson Junctions
summary: Hydrogen contamination in Josephson junctions may contribute to device-to-device variability in superconducting qubits, yet its incorporation, location, and bonding in tunnel barriers remain poorly understood. We combine molecular dynamics simulations of aluminum oxidation in dense O2 and H2O environments with atomistic quantum transport calculations. The simulations produce amorphous AlOx barriers with experimentally relevant hydrogen concentrations.
